response.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, o.recordvault AS recordvault, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope, o.recordvault), scope_stats AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_net WHERE net_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, order_count, avg_net_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) FROM scope_stats) AS diff_from_avg_of_scope_avgs FROM scope_stats
